title: Build-Up of the Year Credit on a Circle Membership
content:
## What is worked out

The benefit credit a membership is granted for the membership year now running is worked out for the member
rather than taken as a single house figure, and it is granted once for that year under the service credit,
the named benefit that goes toward bench and on-site repair labour. This is the credit granted on a
Northbeam Circle Membership.

## The figure the year's credit starts from

The credit granted for a membership year starts from the anniversary reward figure of the tier recorded on
the membership.

## What is taken off for the year already granted

The credit already granted under the service credit inside the membership year is taken off, and the
entries counted for that purpose are the benefit grants booked in the twelve months ending on the handling
day.

## How the year's dues stand

No adjustment is made for how the year's dues stand.

## The order the parts are combined in

The parts are combined in this order: the figure the year's credit starts from, scaled by the spend
multiple, then the addition for work in hand and the addition for tenure, then less the credit already
granted inside the year, and last the adjustment for how the year's dues stand. The result is rounded to
the nearest cent only at the end, no intermediate being rounded, and nothing is granted below nothing.

## The figure worked through on hypothetical inputs

Take a membership on Circle Plus Annual, whose anniversary reward figure is 10.00, and take for this
illustration a spend multiple of 1, no addition for work in hand and no addition for tenure. The figure the
year's credit starts from is 10.00; scaled by a multiple of 1 it stands at 10.00; no adjustment is made for
how the year's dues stand, so with nothing already granted under the service credit inside the membership
year the credit granted for that year, rounded at the end, is 10.00. Had 4.00 already been granted under
the service credit inside the year on the same inputs, the credit granted would be 6.00.
